_about: Freshwater Strategy (News Corp federal polling) one-off and rotating survey questions that do NOT channel into the auspol-tracker data model (voting intention and 2PP are channelled onto the five Freshwater polls.json rows Oct 2025-May 2026). Compiled by reading the five published data-table workbooks (xlsx) linked from freshwaterstrategy.com's polling-data posts, Oct 2025 through May 2026; the /ad-hocs/ Trump favourability series is currently the store's only series, filed at user request 2026-10-17.
_readme: Verification: every grid share and every net-score cell was read programmatically from the published xlsx files (weighted columns) and the five wave totals reconcile Favourable minus Unfavourable = printed NET Total to the first decimal. The question stem, verbatim: 'Below are a list of figures in Australian politics and culture. For each can you say whether you have heard of them, and if so, whether you have a favourable, unfavourable or neutral view of them?' - Trump is one row of that standing heard-of grid, which is why row shares sit in tables[0] with the workbook's own column labels and one decimal place. The NET-by-group table is the workbook's printed 'NET: ... by CROSSBREAKS' row for Trump (a printed Freshwater artefact, not a tracker derivation); crossbreak sets differ by wave (the Oct 2025 wave's age bands are 18-35/36-53/54+, later waves 18-34/35-54/55+; vote intention columns are 2025 recalled vote in Oct 2025/Jan 2026 and current vote intention from Mar 2026). Entry metadata (waveDate/dateStart/published/sample/url) comes from the matching federal polls.json row; the client article named in each note is the polls.json url while the figures live in Freshwater's own data-tables post (tables' source). Inter-wave comparison is legitimate for the headline four rows only - crossbreak definitions shift. The single standing-news-cycle favourability grid means no other Freshwater question is filed here yet.

entries.question: Donald Trump favourability
entries.notes: Nine months into Trump's second term: 24.9% favourable vs 60.9% unfavourable (net -36.0), 13.6% neutral or unsure, and 0.6% have never heard of him. Warmest cohorts are 2025 Coalition voters (net -5.0) and One Nation voters (exactly even, 0.0); coldest are 2025 Greens voters (-68.9) and the residual-state 'Other' group (-57.7). Figures carry the tables' one decimal; the net column is the xlsx's printed NET row.
